messages:
Nina Alvarez: Quick check-in on the routing editor comp: when you stack >8 rules the preview pane gets really noisy and priority badges lose meaning. Two proposals: collapse low-priority rules into a summary row, or add a floating minimap for long stacks. Thoughts?

Theo Martin: I like the summary row for clarity. Minimap feels heavy for small screens. Summary could show "+5 rules collapsed" and allow expand-on-focus. Need to think about keyboard discoverability.

Priya Shah: Agree on summary row. Accessibility note: collapsed rows must preserve semantic order for screen readers (don't visually reorder). Use a single button with aria-expanded and a descriptive label: "Expand 5 hidden rules".

Evan Brooks: UX nit: priority badges are currently small circles with numbers; at small sizes they’re indistinguishable from status dots. Maybe use a pill with text "P3" or move the number into the left gutter. Also allow toggling between numeric and drag-order modes in settings.

Nina Alvarez: Good call. Copy suggestion for validation: instead of "Invalid rule" show inline: "Missing match clause" + link "Fix". Keeps the preview focused and actionable.

design-bot: Layout audit results: 11% overlap of validation chips with preview controls at 360px width; contrast ratio for badge text at default theme: 3.8:1 (target 4.5:1).

Priya Shah: For the preview simulation, can we add a small legend at top-left describing what colors mean? Right now the green/red overlays throw people off. Legend should be keyboard-focusable and read by screen readers.

Evan Brooks: Implementation detail: when collapsing rules, preserve their evaluation order for the simulator. Simulator should still run on the full stack, just hide rows. Also add a lightweight animation to show collapsing so users understand it's not deleted.

Theo Martin: Quick sketch idea: summary row shows condensed stats: "Matched: 12 | Skipped: 3 | Errors: 1". Clicking expands to full rules. Copy for empty state: "No matching rules. Try widening your preview conditions or add a new rule."

QA-Bot: Regression check: keyboard-only expand/collapse tested on chrome/osx/pass: false (issue: focus lands on collapsed summary but arrow keys don't open). Please triage.

Nina Alvarez: Action items: Theo - update comp to include summary row + pill badges. Priya - write aria copy for expand/collapse & legend. Evan - implement preserve-order + collapse animation. I'll update the spec and tag eng. Plan to review Wed morning. :calendar:
